title: Travelstart says a data breach affected some of its customer information
date_note: TimesLIVE (24 Nov) reports that Travelstart identified the breach on 18 November.
geo_basis: country of the TimesLIVE South Africa report; Travelstart's headquarters is not stated in it
summary: TimesLIVE reports that Travelstart says it suffered a data breach of some of its customer information, which it identified on 18 November. ITWeb reports Travelstart saying criminals gained unauthorised access to customer information and that it has identified and contained the attack. Cape Town ETC says the data may include full names, dates of birth, booking references, phone numbers and email addresses; no report gives a number of customers.
plain: Travelstart says some customer information was breached. It says its services remain available and the investigation is ongoing.
exec: Travelstart says some customer information was breached; the reports give no number of customers.
action: Travelstart advises customers not to click links or open attachments in unexpected messages, never to share one-time PINs, passwords or card details, and to verify doubtful messages through its official support channels.

validation.note: TimesLIVE, IT-Online and ITWeb all relay Travelstart's own statement; same underlying statement, so kept single_source. No count given by any.

review.note: stronger than the source: data types now 'may include' per Cape Town ETC; action attributed to Travelstart
